messages:
ops-bot: Incident P0 detected — high token latency in eu-west-1 serving pool. Auto-paged oncall-jordan. Details: /alerts/1952109876 :rotating_light:

oncall-jordan: Acknowledged. Investigating now. Capacity autoscale didn't trigger; checking scheduler logs. ETA 15m.

emma: Thanks J. Can someone draft a short public notice for the status dashboard? I'll coordinate publishing once legal and CS sign off.

oncall-jordan: Draft below — starting point. Please edit for tone.

emma: ```Public incident notice draft (do not publish yet):

• Incident: Elevated inference latency affecting some customers in EU (eu-west-1)
• Impact: Increased response times for text generation and streaming responses for a subset of requests. Some requests may time out.
• Scope: A subset of hosted API customers routed through eu-west-1. Dedicated customers on isolated pools unaffected unless explicitly on eu-west-1.
• Status: Investigating. Mitigation in progress (traffic is being routed to fallback model variants in other regions where possible).
• Next update: 15 minutes

Note: We're prioritizing customer-facing mitigation; engineers are rolling out a config patch.
```

maria-cs: :eyes: Can we add a line about who to contact and whether any SLAs might be impacted? Customers will ask.

lia-legal: Quick note — avoid mentioning specific strategies like 'routing to fallback variants' as that might imply data movement across regions. Suggest: 'we're applying mitigations to restore service; traffic may be redirected to reduce latency' — ok?

emma: Good catch @lia-legal. Updated draft below.

emma: ```Updated public incident notice draft:

• Incident: Elevated inference latency affecting some users in EU (eu-west-1)
• Impact: Increased response times for text generation and streaming. A subset of requests may time out.
• Scope: Hosted API customers with endpoints in eu-west-1. Dedicated or private deployments are unaffected unless they explicitly use eu-west-1.
• Status: Investigating. We are applying mitigations to restore normal performance; traffic may be redirected to reduce latency.
• Contact: Support (support@redwood.ai) and status.redwood.ai for live updates.
• Next update: 15 minutes

We will post a resolved update when normal performance is confirmed.
```

maria-cs: OK from CS. Adding note about support link is great. Approve from our side. :thumbsup:

devex-sam: Small ops note — add a brief 'no data loss' reassurance line: 'No customer data is being deleted or modified; this is a performance issue.' Should be safe.

lia-legal: Approved with that line. Keep the 'no data loss' phrasing.

oncall-jordan: From engineering: root cause likely scheduler OOM causing delayed allocations. Rolling a patch to adjust allocator thresholds now; will monitor.

emma: Given approvals, I'm ready to publish. @hawk-deploy-bot can you run the status dashboard publish? Please mark the update as 'investigating'.

hawk-deploy-bot: Publish request queued. Command: `/status publish --page incidents --body 'Updated incident: investigating — elevated latency in eu-west-1. More updates in 15 minutes.'`

hawk-deploy-bot: Published to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1952109876 — public notice live. :tada:

maria-cs: Posting templated customer message to proactive customers now. Copy: "We're aware of increased latency..." pinging design for email layout.

oncall-jordan: Patch applied at 1952110300. Immediate improvement in allocation success rate. Continuing to monitor.

emma: Monitoring graphs look better. I'll wait 20 minutes and then publish a 'resolved' notice if stable.

lia-legal: OK.

hawk-deploy-bot: Reminder: please update the incident timeline when resolved. I can assist with the resolved template.

oncall-jordan: Confirming stable from 1952110500; error rates back to baseline. Moving to resolved.

emma: Draft resolved notice:

```Resolved: The elevated inference latency in eu-west-1 has been resolved. The root cause was an allocator threshold that caused delayed instance allocations; we deployed a configuration patch which restored normal allocation behavior. Impact: Some hosted API requests in eu-west-1 experienced increased latency and timeouts. No customer data was lost or modified. If you continue to see issues, contact support@redwood.ai.```

maria-cs: Approved. Publishing resolved now.

hawk-deploy-bot: Published resolved notice to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1952109876 — mark: resolved. Incident closed. :white_check_mark:

emma: Thanks team — great coordination. I'll paste a short internal postmortem checklist in a new thread for follow-ups (root cause, RCA, post-incident tasks).

oncall-jordan: Leaving a quick ops note: add autoscaler thresholds to on-call runbook and add a prometheus alert for allocation latency.

maria-cs: I'll follow up with a customer notification summary for impacted tenants.

lia-legal: I'll review the postmortem draft before public sharing.

emma: Thread closed. Thanks all. :heart:
